units.source_text: But here’s the chicken-and-egg problem. What if you’re so far inside the child-state that you can’t become the adult?
units.output_text: What If I Can’t Get To The Adult Position?

units.source_text: This is much easier when you can already reach one of those adult roles.
units.output_text: The problem with this exercise is that if you are deep in a child state, you may not be able to access the adult in you to do the work of rebirthing that wounded child. This is much easier if you can access one of the adult roles.

units.source_text: Without that, you can sit there trying to say all the loving things while the old critic, numbness, panic, or urge to get away is running the whole thing.
